Compact and uncompact sets of H3 cells

Source: R/h3_hierarchy.R
ddbh3_compact.Rd

Compact a set of H3 cells into the smallest set of (possibly coarser) cells covering the same area, or uncompact a set of cells to a single resolution

Usage

ddbh3_compact(
  x,
  h3 = "h3string",
  by = NULL,
  new_column = "h3compact",
  nested = FALSE,
  conn = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

ddbh3_uncompact(
  x,
  h3 = "h3string",
  resolution = 8,
  new_column = "h3uncompact",
  nested = FALSE,
  conn = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  mode = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

x

Input data. One of:

duckspatial_df

A lazy spatial data frame via dbplyr.

sf

A spatial data frame.

tbl_lazy

A lazy data frame from dbplyr.

data.frame

A standard R data frame.

character string

A table or view name in conn.

character vector

A vector of values to operate on in vectorized mode (requires conn = NULL).

h3

The name of a column in x containing the H3 strings or H3 unsigned 64-bit integers (UBIGINT)

by

Character vector with the names of the columns used to group the cells before compacting them (e.g. one compacted set per region). If NULL (default), all the cells of x are compacted together.

new_column

Name of the new column to create on the input data. Defaults to "h3compact" for ddbh3_compact() and "h3uncompact" for ddbh3_uncompact().

nested

Logical. If TRUE, the cells are returned as a nested list column (one row per group in ddbh3_compact(), one row per input row in ddbh3_uncompact()). If FALSE (default), the result is unnested so each cell occupies its own row.

conn

A connection object to a DuckDB database. If NULL, the function runs on a temporary DuckDB database.

name

A character string of length one specifying the name of the table, or a character string of length two specifying the schema and table names. If NULL (the default), the function returns the result as an sf object

overwrite

Boolean. whether to overwrite the existing table if it exists. Defaults to FALSE. This argument is ignored when name is NULL.

quiet

A logical value. If TRUE, suppresses any informational messages. Defaults to FALSE.

resolution

A number specifying the resolution of the uncompacted cells (between 0 and 15). It must be equal to or finer than the resolution of every input cell.

mode

Character. Controls the return type. Options:

  • "duckspatial" (default): Lazy spatial data frame backed by dbplyr/DuckDB

  • "sf": Eagerly collected sf object (uses memory)

Can be set globally via ddbs_options(mode = "...") or per-function via this argument. Per-function overrides global setting. It only applies when the output has a geometry column, and is ignored otherwise.

Value

For ddbh3_compact(), a tbl_lazy (or TRUE invisibly if name is provided). For ddbh3_uncompact(), the same outputs as the rest of the package:

tbl_lazy

If x is not spatial. mode is ignored in this case.

duckspatial_df

If x is spatial (e.g. an sf or duckspatial_df object) and mode = "duckspatial" (default).

sf

If x is spatial and mode = "sf".

TRUE (invisibly)

If name is provided, a table is created in the connection and TRUE is returned invisibly.

In vectorized mode (x is a vector of cells and conn = NULL), both functions return a vector with the compacted or uncompacted set of cells.

Details

  • ddbh3_compact() is an aggregation: it replaces every complete set of children by their parent, recursively. The output only keeps the by columns and the compacted cells, and it is never spatial (use ddbh3_h3_to_spatial() to get the hexagons). Duplicated cells are removed before compacting. If a group contains invalid cells, its result is NULL (with nested = TRUE) or the group is dropped (with nested = FALSE). The h3 column can also be a list column of cells.

  • ddbh3_uncompact() expands each cell (or each list of cells, if h3 is a list column) to all its descendants at resolution. Cells already at resolution are kept. It keeps the rest of the columns. If a cell is finer than resolution, the result for that row is NULL (with nested = TRUE) or the row is dropped (with nested = FALSE).

Inside dplyr, ddbh3_compact(h3) works as an aggregate function in summarise(), and ddbh3_uncompact(h3, resolution) works in mutate() on a list column of cells.

Examples

## Load needed packages
library(duckh3)
library(dplyr)
#> 
#> Attaching package: ‘dplyr’
#> The following objects are masked from ‘package:stats’:
#> 
#>     filter, lag
#> The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’:
#> 
#>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union

## Setup the default connection with h3 and spatial extensions
## This is a mandatory step to use duckh3 functions
ddbh3_default_conn(threads = 1)
#> duckdb keeps downloaded extensions and secrets in a temporary directory:
#> ℹ /tmp/RtmpuK9Fi7/duckdb
#> This is removed when the R session ends.
#> • Extensions are re-downloaded each session.
#> • Secrets are lost.
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = TRUE) (or create ~/.duckdb) to keep them (suitable for most users).
#> ℹ Run duckdb(shared_home = FALSE) to accept the temporary directory (and silence this message).
#> ℹ See ?duckdb_storage for details and alternatives.

## All the children of two cells, plus one extra cell
cells_tbl <- data.frame(
  region   = c("A", "B", "B"),
  h3string = c("87283472bffffff", "872834729ffffff", "88283470a1fffff")
) |>
  ddbh3_get_children(resolution = 8, h3 = "h3string", new_column = "h3children")

## COMPACT ------------------

## Compact all the cells together
ddbh3_compact(cells_tbl, h3 = "h3children")
#> # A query:  ?? x 1
#> # Database: DuckDB 2.0.1 [unknown@Linux 7.0.0-1020-azure:R 4.6.2/:memory:]
#>   h3compact      
#>   <chr>          
#> 1 88283470a1fffff
#> 2 872834729ffffff
#> 3 87283472bffffff

## Compact the cells of each region
compact_tbl <- ddbh3_compact(cells_tbl, h3 = "h3children", by = "region")
compact_tbl
#> # A query:  ?? x 2
#> # Database: DuckDB 2.0.1 [unknown@Linux 7.0.0-1020-azure:R 4.6.2/:memory:]
#>   region h3compact      
#>   <chr>  <chr>          
#> 1 A      87283472bffffff
#> 2 B      88283470a1fffff
#> 3 B      872834729ffffff

## One row per region with a list of cells
ddbh3_compact(cells_tbl, h3 = "h3children", by = "region", nested = TRUE)
#> # A query:  ?? x 2
#> # Database: DuckDB 2.0.1 [unknown@Linux 7.0.0-1020-azure:R 4.6.2/:memory:]
#>   region h3compact
#>   <chr>  <list>   
#> 1 A      <chr [1]>
#> 2 B      <chr [2]>

## Inside summarise
cells_tbl |>
  summarise(h3compact = ddbh3_compact(h3children), .by = region)
#> # A query:  ?? x 2
#> # Database: DuckDB 2.0.1 [unknown@Linux 7.0.0-1020-azure:R 4.6.2/:memory:]
#>   region h3compact
#>   <chr>  <list>   
#> 1 A      <chr [1]>
#> 2 B      <chr [2]>

## UNCOMPACT ----------------

## Back to resolution 8
ddbh3_uncompact(compact_tbl, h3 = "h3compact", resolution = 8)
#> # A query:  ?? x 3
#> # Database: DuckDB 2.0.1 [unknown@Linux 7.0.0-1020-azure:R 4.6.2/:memory:]
#>    region h3compact       h3uncompact    
#>    <chr>  <chr>           <chr>          
#>  1 A      87283472bffffff 88283472b1fffff
#>  2 A      87283472bffffff 88283472b3fffff
#>  3 A      87283472bffffff 88283472b5fffff
#>  4 A      87283472bffffff 88283472b7fffff
#>  5 A      87283472bffffff 88283472b9fffff
#>  6 A      87283472bffffff 88283472bbfffff
#>  7 A      87283472bffffff 88283472bdfffff
#>  8 B      88283470a1fffff 88283470a1fffff
#>  9 B      872834729ffffff 8828347291fffff
#> 10 B      872834729ffffff 8828347293fffff
#> 11 B      872834729ffffff 8828347295fffff
#> 12 B      872834729ffffff 8828347297fffff
#> 13 B      872834729ffffff 8828347299fffff
#> 14 B      872834729ffffff 882834729bfffff
#> 15 B      872834729ffffff 882834729dfffff

## Vectorized mode
ddbh3_uncompact("87283472bffffff", resolution = 8) |>
  ddbh3_compact()
#> [1] "87283472bffffff"
